title: The New chat tooltip readable again, white text on the dark green, and every font one step larger
request: The owner sent a screenshot of the sidebar and asked what the black box at the top was, then asked: make fonts bigger, just one size.
spec: The tooltip and every element that draws text on the dark green are readable in both themes; all text, including the sizes that were fixed in pixels, is one step (about 7%) larger.
plan: Find the tooltip's colour rule and every other use of the same text colour.
Fix the colour at the token, not element by element.
Make the fixed pixel sizes follow the font scale, then raise the scale one step.
Check computed colours and sizes in the running app, and that nothing scrolls sideways.

decisions.decision: Set --ts-on-brand back to white and keep --ts-on-accent dark.
decisions.why: v6 made --ts-on-brand dark for the bright green buttons, but the tooltip, the avatar, the current step's badge, a pressed decision and the notebook's finding buttons draw it on near-black or the dark green; the bright green buttons already use --ts-on-accent.

decisions.decision: Raise --font-scale from 1 to 1.07 and route the 26 fixed sizes in ds.css through it.
decisions.why: Almost every size already multiplies the scale; one number moves all text by one step, and the fixed ones would otherwise stay behind.

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/ds.css (--ts-on-brand #FFFFFF; .dc-tip text from --ts-surface; --font-scale 1.07; font-size Npx written as calc(Npx * var(--font-scale, 1))); static/app rebuilt.

findings.defect: The New chat tooltip showed as a black box with unreadable text.
findings.scenario: Point at New chat in the sidebar; the hint 'Start a fresh chat or ML project' is dark text on near-black.
findings.cause: The tooltip's text used --ts-on-brand, which v6 had made dark green.
findings.fix: The tooltip uses the surface colour for its text, and --ts-on-brand is white again.
findings.test: In the running app the tooltip and the avatar compute to white text on a dark background.

findings.defect: Five more elements drew dark text on the dark green.
findings.scenario: The avatar, the current workflow step's badge, a pressed decision, the notebook's finding buttons.
findings.test: Contrast of white on #237A2D is about 5.3:1.

measurements.name: computed font sizes after the step
measurements.gate: every text larger, nothing wider than the page
measurements.result: Body 14.4 px (was 13.5), titles 30 px, menu items 15.5 px, project tabs 16 px; the page is as wide as the window.
limits: Checked on the Dashboard at desktop width; the browser suite checks every page at desktop and phone widths.

outcome: The tooltip and the dark-green elements are readable, and all text is one step larger.
lessons: When a colour token changes meaning, search every rule that uses it: a button's text colour was also a tooltip's.
A type scale works only if every size goes through it; fixed pixel sizes stay behind when it moves.
risks: Larger text makes some long labels wrap sooner on narrow screens.
